mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (id, conversation_id, role, content, status, sources_json, token_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{conversationId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{status}, #{sourcesJson}, #{tokenCount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET status = #{status}, content = #{content}, sources_json = #{sourcesJson}, token_count = #{tokenCount}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, role, content, status, sources_json, token_count, created_at, updated_at FROM message WHERE id = #{id}
